{{Quote|He ''[Nahdonnis Praji]'' was an old-fashioned military man and while he viewed the AT walkers as graceless brutes he had to admit they were effective, particularly in subduing the unruly Leffingites in the Battle of Almak.|Doctor Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
'''Almak''' was a terrestrial<ref name="Tinker" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE Almak" /> located in the [[Almak system/Legends|Almak system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Almak sector/Legends|Almak sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="CSWE Almak" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Leffingite/Legends|Leffingite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="DB" /> and shared its name with the [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] known as the [[Almakian apple/Legends|Almakian apple]].<ref name="DaD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>

The Leffingite [[Magaloof/Legends|Magaloof]] hailed from Almak. He traveled to<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="DB" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="22 BBY">The events described in {{DB|character|magaloof|Magaloof}} begin concurrently with those of {{Film|II}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> and started a criminal career there. Eventually, Magaloof was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]], and after serving a three-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] sentence, he returned home to Almak to start over his life.<ref name="DB" />

At some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="BattleDate">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}} establishes that the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fought in the [[Battle of Almak]] at some point by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Declaration of a New Order|foundation]] of the Empire to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the battle must have been fought between those two dates.</ref> the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] subdued the Leffingites, who were resisting that government, during the [[Battle of Almak]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] later mentioned the battle in the [[104 ABY]] article "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].<ref name="Tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Magaloof's homeworld, Almak, is just random letters that sounded good together.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|7|Magaloof: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Almak was developed as part of the backstory for Magaloof,<ref name="DB" /> a character appearing in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Gregory Walker]], writing as "NarbFlick,"<ref name="DaD" /> submitted an entry for Magaloof<ref name="DB" /> through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]," and it was added to the site's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] on [[August 12]], [[2005]].<ref name="What's The Story">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20050812.html|text=Hyperspace Presents: What's the Story, Round 1}}</ref>

Walker later claimed that Almak's name was simply derived from "random letters that sounded good together."<ref name="Blog" /> The author also expressed his intention for Almak to be located in the vicinity of the planet [[Luptoom]],<ref name="Blog Hida">{{Blog|narbflick|9|Nar Hida: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> which had also been created by Walker via "What's The Story?".<ref name="DB Hida">{{DB|character|narhida|Hida, Nar}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Almak [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Almak itself, in grid square J-17, while placing the [[Luptoom system/Legends|Luptoom system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], grid square M-18.<ref name="TEA" />
